exams.notes: Applicants must pass the required examinations for licensure; NBEO is explicitly referenced for the clinical skills examination and the TPA certification exam.
exams.quote: the board shall issue a temporary license to practice optometry to a person who applies for and is eligible for licensure pursuant to Section 3046, but who is unable to immediately take the Part III - Patient Encounters and Performance Skills Examination developed by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO), required for licensure under this chapter

exams.name: California jurisprudence examination
exams.notes: Required for licensure by endorsement (Section 3057) and for faculty licensure (Section 3056); also required for restoration of expired licenses.
exams.quote: Has successfully passed the board's jurisprudence examination.

exams.name: NBEO Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease examination
exams.notes: Required for TPA certification for optometrists who graduated from an accredited school before January 1, 1996.
exams.quote: Passes the National Board of Examiners in Optometry's "Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease" examination or, in the event this examination is no longer offered, its equivalent, as determined by the California State Board of Optometry.

interval_years.quote: An optometric license issued under this chapter expires at midnight on the last day of the month in which the license was issued during the second year of a two-year term if not renewed.

required.quote: The board shall adopt regulations that require, as a condition to the renewal thereof, that all holders of licenses submit proof satisfactory to the board that they have informed themselves of the developments in the practice of optometry occurring since the original issuance of their licenses by pursuing one or more courses of study satisfactory to the board

hours_per_period.quote: An optometrist certified to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents pursuant to Section 3041.3 shall complete a total of 50 hours of continuing education every two years in order to renew his or her certificate.

period_years.quote: An optometrist certified to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents pursuant to Section 3041.3 shall complete a total of 50 hours of continuing education every two years in order to renew his or her certificate.

topical_requirements.quote: Thirty-five of the required 50 hours of continuing education shall be on the diagnosis, treatment, and management of ocular disease in any combination of the following areas: (1) Glaucoma. (2) Has successfully passed the licensing examination for an optometric license in another state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate, or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter or board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter or any of the rules and regulations adopted by the board pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of optometry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Two or more negligent acts or omissions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated negligent acts. To be repeated, there must be two or more negligent acts or omissions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of optometry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of fraud, misrepresentation, or any act involving dishonesty or corruption substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of an optometrist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of fraud, misrepresentation, or any act involving dishonesty or corruption, that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of advertising relating to optometry that violates Section 651 or 17500.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of advertising relating to optometry that violates Section 651 or 17500.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial of licensure, revocation, suspension, restriction, or other disciplinary action by another state, governmental agency, or California health care professional licensing board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Denial of licensure, revocation, suspension, restriction, or any other disciplinary action against a health care professional license by another state or territory of the United States, by any other governmental agency, or by another California health care professional licensing board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring a license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring his or her license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of an optometrist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of an optometrist, in which event the record of the conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Self-administration of controlled substances or dangerous drugs, or use of alcoholic beverages to a dangerous extent or in a manner impairing ability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering to himself or herself any controlled substance or using any of the dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or using alcoholic beverages to the extent, or in a manner, as to be dangerous or injurious to the person applying for a license or holding a license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing or soliciting a sexually related crime substantially related to optometry duties; sexual abuse or misconduct with a patient; conviction requiring sex offender registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing or soliciting an act punishable as a sexually related crime, if that act or solicitation is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated acts of excessive prescribing, furnishing, or administering controlled substances or dangerous drugs, or excessive treatment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated acts of excessive prescribing, furnishing, or administering of controlled substances or dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or repeated acts of excessive treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated acts of excessive use of diagnostic or therapeutic procedures, or excessive use of diagnostic or treatment facilities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated acts of excessive use of diagnostic or therapeutic procedures, or repeated acts of excessive use of diagnostic or treatment facilities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, furnishing, or administering controlled substances or drugs without a good faith prior examination and optometric reason.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The prescribing, furnishing, or administering of controlled substances or drugs specified in Section 4022, or treatment without a good faith prior examination of the patient and optometric reason.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to patients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to his or her patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing, or holding oneself out as being able to perform, or offering to perform, professional services beyond the scope of the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, or holding oneself out as being able to perform, or offering to perform, any professional services beyond the scope of the license authorized by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The practice of optometry without a valid, unrevoked, unexpired license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of optometry without a valid, unrevoked, unexpired license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, directly or indirectly, any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform any work for which a license is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing, directly or indirectly, of any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform any work for which an optometry license is required.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the licensee's optometry license for any purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting another person to use the licensee's optometry license for any purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering with fraudulent intent a license or using a fraudulently altered license, permit, certification, or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering with fraudulent intent a license issued by the board, or using a fraudulently altered license, permit certification or any registration issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines, risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, thereby risking transmission of bloodborne infectious diseases from optometrist to patient, from patient to patient, or from patient to optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to comply with a request for patient clinical records accompanied by written authorization within 15 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to comply with a request for the clinical records of a patient, that is accompanied by that patient's written authorization for release of records to the board, within 15 days of receiving the request and authorization

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to refer a patient to an appropriate physician and surgeon if an examination indicates a substantial likelihood of pathology requiring that physician's attention.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to refer a patient to an appropriate physician and surgeon if an examination of the eyes indicates a substantial likelihood of any pathology that requires the attention of that physician and surgeon.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The owner and operator of a mobile optometric office shall register with the board.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry includes the diagnosis, prevention, treatment, and management of disorders and dysfunctions of the visual system, as authorized by this chapter, as well as the provision of habilitative or rehabilitative optometric services, and is the doing of any or all of the following: (1) The examination of the human eyes and their adnexa ... (2) The determination of the powers or range of human vision ... (3) The prescribing, using, or directing the use of any optical device in connection with ocular exercises, visual training, vision training, or orthoptics. (4) The prescribing, fitting, or adaptation of contact and spectacle lenses ... (5) For an optometrist certified pursuant to Section 3041.3, diagnosing and preventing conditions and diseases of the human eyes and their adnexa, and treating nonmalignant conditions and diseases of the anterior segment ...
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry includes the diagnosis, prevention, treatment, and management of disorders and dysfunctions of the visual system, as authorized by this chapter, as well as the provision of habilitative or rehabilitative optometric services

drug_authority.value: TPA-certified optometrists may prescribe topical and oral prescription and nonprescription therapeutic pharmaceutical agents that are not controlled substances; may prescribe oral analgesic controlled substances codeine with compounds, hydrocodone with compounds, and tramadol limited to three days; if also glaucoma-certified, may prescribe topical and oral antiglaucoma agents; all diagnostic pharmaceutical agents not controlled substances are authorized for all licensees.
drug_authority.quote: Using or prescribing, including for rational off-label purposes, topical and oral prescription and nonprescription therapeutic pharmaceutical agents that are not controlled substances and are not antiglaucoma agents or limited or excluded by subdivision (b).

surgery_prohibited.quote: Performing surgery is excluded from the practice of optometry. "Surgery" means any act in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by any means.

surgery_definition.value: Any act in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by any means. It does not mean an act that solely involves the administration or prescribing of a topical or oral therapeutic pharmaceutical.
surgery_definition.quote: "Surgery" means any act in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by any means. It does not mean an act that solely involves the administration or prescribing of a topical or oral therapeutic pharmaceutical.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Foreign body and staining removal from the cornea, eyelid, and conjunctiva with any appropriate instrument. Removal of corneal foreign bodies and any related stain shall, as relevant, be limited to that which is nonperforating, no deeper than the midstroma, and not reasonably anticipated to require surgical repair.

value: Corneal scraping with cultures
Debridement of corneal epithelium not associated with band keratopathy
Mechanical epilation
Collection of blood by skin puncture or venipuncture for laboratory testing
Suture removal subject to comanagement requirements
Treatment or removal of sebaceous cysts by expression
Lacrimal punctal occlusion using plugs, or placement of a stent or similar device in a lacrimal canaliculus
Foreign body and staining removal from the cornea, eyelid, and conjunctiva
Lacrimal irrigation and dilation in patients 12 years of age or over (excluding probing of the nasolacrimal tract)
Administration of oral fluorescein for ocular angiography
Intravenous injection for ocular angiography at direction of an ophthalmologist
Use of noninvasive devices delivering intense pulsed light therapy or low-level light therapy (adnexa only)
Use of an intranasal stimulator for dry eye syndrome
Skin testing for ocular allergies limited to superficial layer of skin
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Performing the following procedures, which are excluded from restrictions imposed on the performance of surgery by paragraph (6) of subdivision (b), unless explicitly indicated

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: If also certified under subdivision (c), using or prescribing topical and oral antiglaucoma agents for the medical treatment of all primary open-angle, exfoliation, pigmentary, and steroid-induced glaucomas in persons 18 years of age or over.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: The prescribing, using, or directing the use of any optical device in connection with ocular exercises, visual training, vision training, or orthoptics.

immunization_authority.quote: If also certified under subdivision (d), independent initiation and administration of immunizations for influenza, herpes zoster virus, pneumococcus, and SARS-CoV-2 in compliance with recommendations adopted pursuant to Section 120164 of the Health and Safety Code in persons 18 years of age or older.

value: Oral analgesic controlled substances limited to: codeine with compounds, hydrocodone with compounds, and tramadol
All other controlled substances excluded from optometric prescribing
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Prescribing the oral analgesic controlled substance codeine with compounds, hydrocodone with compounds, and tramadol as listed in the California Uniform Controlled Substances Act

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: Prescribing the oral analgesic controlled substance codeine with compounds, hydrocodone with compounds, and tramadol as listed in the California Uniform Controlled Substances Act (Division 10 (commencing with Section 11000) of the Health and Safety Code) and the United States Uniform Controlled Substances Act (21 U.S.C. Sec. 801 et seq.), limited to three days, with referral to an ophthalmologist if the pain persists.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Using or prescribing, including for rational off-label purposes, topical and oral prescription and nonprescription therapeutic pharmaceutical agents that are not controlled substances and are not antiglaucoma agents or limited or excluded by subdivision (b).

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: In order to be certified to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents and authorized to diagnose and treat the conditions listed in subdivisions (b) and (d) of Section 3041, an optometrist shall apply for a certificate from the board and meet all requirements imposed by the board.

dea_registration_required.quote: Has furnished a signed release allowing the disclosure of information from the National Practitioner Data Bank and, if applicable, the verification of registration status with the federal Drug Enforcement Administration.

value: Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agents (TPA) certification
Glaucoma treatment certification
Immunization certificate
specialty_certification_types.quote: In order to be certified to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents and authorized to diagnose and treat the conditions listed in subdivisions (b) and (d) of Section 3041, an optometrist shall apply for a certificate from the board

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: Successfully completes a minimum of 100 hours of directed and accredited education in ocular and systemic diseases within two years prior to meeting the requirements of paragraph (1).

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: Completes a preceptorship of no less than 65 hours, during a period of not less than two months nor more than one year, with either a TPA-certified optometrist in good standing or a physician and surgeon board-certified in ophthalmology in good standing.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: An optometrist shall consult with and, if necessary, refer to a physician and surgeon or other appropriate health care provider when a situation or condition occurs that is beyond the optometrists's scope of practice.

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: Treatment with topical and oral medications authorized in subdivision (a) related to an ocular surgery shall be comanaged with the ophthalmologist that performed the surgery, or another ophthalmologist designated by that surgeon, during the customary preoperative and postoperative period for the procedure.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, an assistant in any setting where optometry or ophthalmology is practiced who is acting under the direct responsibility and supervision of an optometrist or a physician and surgeon may fit prescription lenses.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: An optometrist licensed under this chapter is subject to the provisions of Section 2290.5 for purposes of practicing telehealth.

mobile_office_authorized.quote: "mobile optometric office" means a trailer, van, or other means of transportation in which the practice of optometry, as defined in Section 3041, is performed

home_visit_permit_required.quote: An optometrist who is certified as a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent pursuant to Section 3041.3 may, in the form and manner prescribed by the board, submit an application to the board for a home residence permit

maximum_number_of_offices.quote: No optometrist, and no two or more optometrists jointly, may have more than 11 offices.

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: The expiration date of a contact lens prescription shall not be less than one year and shall not exceed two years from the date of issuance

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: A spectacle lens prescription shall include all of the following: (1) The dioptric power of the lens.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: An optometrist shall retain a patient's records for a minimum of seven years from the date he or she completes treatment of the patient.

limited_teaching_license_available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice optometry to a person who meets all of the following qualifications: (1) Has a degree as a doctor of optometry issued by an accredited school or college of optometry. (2) Is currently licensed in another state. (3) Is currently a full-time faculty member of an accredited California school or college of optometry

retired_license_status_available.quote: The board shall issue, upon application and payment of the fee described in Section 3152, a retired license to an optometrist who holds a license that is current.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: Has successfully passed the board's jurisprudence examination.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: Regulations require the submission of fingerprints prior to issuance of the temporary license. Due to a change in the regulations, fingerprints are now checked by the Department of Justice (DOJ) and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).
